description: Matching Regional Hiring Trends to Climate Action Plans Creates Training & Career Opportunities is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Long Beach City College Workforce and Economic Development Division. Long Beach City College took the unusual step of creating a Resilience & Sustainability team within its Workforce and Economic Development Division to better align educational offerings with the water and power resilience needs of cities throughout Los Angeles County. Coverage: Los Angeles County, CA (2025). The toolkit gives Los Angeles County, CA as the location, 2025 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
